name: Earth Invaders
author: Yara F. Scramin
description: Space Invaders turned around: Earth is the enemy. Destroy human ships, dodge bullets and unleash your ultimate. Arrows to move, X to shoot, Z for the ultimate.

descriptions.en: Space Invaders turned around: Earth is the enemy. Destroy human ships, dodge bullets and unleash your ultimate. Arrows to move, X to shoot, Z for the ultimate.
descriptions.it: Space Invaders al contrario: il nemico è la Terra. Distruggi le navi umane, schiva i proiettili e scatena la mossa finale. Frecce per muoverti, X spara, Z mossa finale.
